1199b: Narrated 'Abdullah: (through another chain of narrators) similarly, from the Prophet (ﷺ).
1390b:
Narrated Sufyan At-Tammar:

That he saw the grave of the Prophet (ﷺ) raised in the shape of a hump.
1132b:
Narrated Al-Ash'ath:

When he (the Prophet) heard the crowing of a cock, he would get up and pray.
1228b: Narrated Salama bin Alqama: I said to Muhammad, "Is there a Tashahhud after the two prostrations of Sahw (forgetfulness)?" He said, "It is not mentioned in the Hadith of Abu Huraira."
2214b: Narrated Musaddad: `Abdul-Wahid narrated to us with this chain, and he said, "In every (property) that has not been divided." Hisham followed him (in narrating it) from Ma`mar. `Abdur-Razzaq said, "In every property." It was narrated by `Abdur-Rahman bin Ishaq from Az-Zuhri.
1390c:
Narrated Hisham bin `Urwa:

That his father said, "When the wall fell down on them in the time of Al-Walid bin `Abdul Malik, they set about rebuilding it, and a foot appeared to them, and they got scared, and thought that it was the foot of the Prophet (ﷺ). But nobody could be found to know that (for certain) till `Urwa said to them, 'By Allah, this is not the foot of the Prophet (ﷺ), but it is the foot of `Umar (ﷺ).'"
2240b: Narrated Ibn Abi Najih: (through a different chain) "So let him pay in advance for a specified measure to be delivered at a specified time."
2437b: Narrated Shu`ba: From Salama with this (chain), he said, "Then I met him afterwards at Mecca, and he said, 'I do not know whether it was three years or one year.'"
3595b:
Narrated Muhill bin Khalifa:

I heard `Adi say, "I was with the Prophet (ﷺ)."
2239b:
Narrated Ibn Abi Najih:

The same Hadith (as above) with the addition, "...for a known measure and a known weight."
774b: And 'Ubaidullah said, on the authority of Thabit, that Anas (رضى الله عنه) said: There was a man from the Ansar who used to lead them in prayer in the mosque of Quba', and whenever he started a Surah with which he used to lead them in the prayer, from among the Surahs which he recited, he would start with "Say: He is Allah, the One" (Surat-Al-Ikhlas) till he finished it, and then he would recite another Surah along with it; and he used to do this in every Rak`a. So his companions spoke to him and said, "You recite this Surah, and then you think that it is not sufficient, so you recite another Surah? Either recite it alone, or leave it and recite another Surah." He said, "I am not going to leave it. If you like that I should lead you (in prayer) with it, I will continue to do so, and if you do not like it, I will leave you (i.e., leave leading you in prayer)." And they used to consider him as the best of them (in leading the prayer), and they disliked that anyone else should lead them (in prayer). So when the Prophet (ﷺ) came to them, they mentioned this news to him. He said, "O so-and-so! What prevents you from doing what your companions order you to do, and what makes you insist on reciting this Surah in every Rak`a?" The man said, "I love it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your love for it will make you enter Paradise."
3963b: Narrated Anas bin Malik: Similarly (as above).
3562b: Narrated Muhammad bin Bashshar: Yahya and Ibn Mahdi narrated to us, they said: Shu`ba narrated to us the like of it, adding: "And if he disliked a thing, it would be recognized on his face."
3756b: Narrated by Abu Ma'mar: Narrated by 'Abdul Warith, and he said, "Teach him the Book." Narrated by Musa: Narrated by Wuhaib, from Khalid, similarly. And Al-Hikmah (wisdom) means correctness (in speech and action) other than prophethood.
4945b:
Narrated `Ali:

We were sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then he mentioned the Hadith (i.e., the above narration).
5470b: Narrated Muhammad: (from Anas) and he narrated the Hadith.
4931b: Narrated Al-Aswad: `Abdullah said, "While we were in a cave with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Surat-al-Mursalat was revealed to him, and we took it from his mouth (i.e. as he recited it), and it was still fresh in his mouth (i.e. he had just then finished reciting it), when a snake came out and we tried to hit and kill it, but it escaped before us. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "It has escaped its evil and you have escaped its evil."
5032b: Narrated 'Uthman: Jarir narrated to us from Mansur, a similar (Hadith). Bishr followed him (i.e., Jarir) narrating from Ibn Al-Mubarak, from Shu'ba. And Ibn Juraij followed him (i.e., Mansur) narrating from 'Abda, from Shaqiq who said: I heard 'Abdullah saying: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) (saying so).
5037b:
Narrated Hisham: (through another chain) "I dropped them from such-and-such Surah."

This has been narrated by 'Ali bin Mus-hir and 'Abda from Hisham as well.
5441b:
Narrated Abu Huraira:

The Prophet (ﷺ) distributed dates among us, and my share of them was five, four dates and one Hashafa (a date which dried on the tree before it was fully ripe). Then I saw that the Hashafa was the hardest of them for my teeth.
5944b: Narrated Sufyan: I mentioned to `Abdur-Rahman bin `Abis the Hadith narrated by Mansur, from Ibrahim, from `Alqama, from `Abdullah. He said, "I heard it from Um Ya`qub, from `Abdullah, similar to the Hadith of Mansur."
5051b: 'Ali said: Sufyan said: Mansur informed us, on the authority of Ibrahim, that `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid told him that `Alqama told him, on the authority of Abu Mas`ud -- and I met him while he was going around the Ka`ba -- who mentioned the statement of the Prophet (ﷺ): "Whoever recites the last two Verses of Surat-al-Baqara at night, they will be sufficient for him."'
402b: Narrated Anas: (through another chain) with this.
6895b:
Narrated Ibn `Abbas:

I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying something similar to it.
6908b: Narrated Muhammad bin `Abdullah: Muhammad bin Sabiq told us, Za'idah told us, Hisham bin `Urwa told us, from his father, that he heard Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba narrating from `Umar, that he consulted them regarding a miscarried fetus of a woman, similar to it.
